content.short: Kite is an AI-powered Web3 wallet and decentralized payment infrastructure for seamless transactions.
content.description: Kite is a next-generation Web3 wallet and decentralized payment platform that integrates artificial intelligence to simplify user interactions. Designed to bridge the gap between complex blockchain infrastructure and everyday usability, Kite offers intuitive asset management, automated intent-based transactions, and secure cross-chain capabilities. By focusing on user-centric design, it provides an essential toolkit for both retail users and institutional participants.
